text: Could you make a logo for my bakery? I’ve been excited about finally having a logo for it, so I’m probably explaining this in more detail than I need to. The bakery is called Mooncrumb, and I want the logo to be square. For the design, I’d like a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Please send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds. I don’t want a white box behind it.
